formula: target = clip(sum_k w_k * s_k, 0, 1), with the components s_k of data/pairs/{split}_pairs.npz (float32 arrays, converted to float64 before weighting; the study stored the result as float32)

heuristic.description: fixed weights of the original method

uniform.description: equal weights for the six components

learnability_aware.description: weight of each component proportional to the validation R2, clipped at zero, of a model trained to predict that component alone; components with negative R2 get zero weight
learnability_aware.rule: w_k = max(R2_val_k, 0) / sum_m max(R2_val_m, 0); validation data only

source: training configurations of the study; identical for training seeds 42, 43 and 44
